evidence.text: builds `%s\DATA\MUSIC.DAT`, copies the name, and opens the member `melodic.bnk` (or `drum.bnk`) through the member open `0x4c08d`

the body continues past the first 72-instruction block to the full 688-byte extent: it opens melodic.bnk and drum.bnk, reads both through resource_read, installs them for the driver values 0xa002 and 0xa009, and reports the statuses 1, 2, and 3

name: music_bank_load
role: Loads the melodic and drum music banks through the sound driver and sets the bank status.
